question: 'File Name: clarity/src/vm/costs/costs_4.rs -> Scope: Critical. Show an unprivileged attacker taking a validly signed transaction and mutating it into a different executed transaction with the same recovered signer. Identity: the transaction the recovered public key authenticated == the transaction the node executes and charges.'
